patch.label: Quick Zabimaru Swipe
patch.description: Fast high blade swipe with a tiny active window and quick guarded recovery.

applied.reason: Short standing sword swipe hits high and returns quickly.

patch.label: Low Zabimaru Sweep
patch.description: Instant low sweep with very long active blade pressure across the floor.

applied.reason: The blade stays low through a long sliding sweep sequence.

patch.label: Zabimaru Body Slash
patch.description: Quick mid sword slash with a brief active cut and steady recovery.

applied.reason: Compact horizontal blade swing crosses the torso line.

patch.label: Zabimaru Driving Cut
patch.description: Fast mid driving slash with very long active blade travel and quick finish.

applied.reason: Long sequence keeps the sword extended at body height.

patch.label: Heavy Zabimaru Cleave
patch.description: Slow mid cleave with a long active sword arc and punishable windup.

applied.reason: Overhead-to-forward blade sequence reads as a committed mid cleave.

patch.label: Zabimaru Rising Launcher
patch.description: Slow mid launcher that lifts through a rising sword arc and recovers quickly.

applied.reason: Blade rises upward through the opponent line and already has launcher data.

patch.label: Low Zabimaru Knockdown

applied.reason: Low blade sweep finishes as an authored knockdown ender.

patch.label: Low Zabimaru Feint

applied.reason: Low sequence moves the blade along the floor before snapping upright.

patch.label: Zabimaru Driving Sweep
patch.description: Slow low knockdown sweep with long active reach and a fast finish.

applied.reason: Crouched sliding blade sweep stays low and carries knockdown.

patch.label: Zabimaru Power Crush
patch.description: Quick mid knockdown crush with a very long active sword flourish.

applied.reason: Wide blade flourish and impact effect support a heavy mid knockdown.

patch.label: Crouch Blade Rush

applied.reason: Full-crouch move chains several low-stance sword swipes at body height.

patch.label: Crouch Zabimaru Launcher
patch.description: Steady mid crouch launcher with a tiny active window and high recovery.

applied.reason: Crouching upward sword cut matches the authored launch height.

patch.description: Fast high overdrive slash with a short active bite and steady recovery.

applied.reason: Overdrive version mirrors the high Zabimaru swipe.

patch.label: Zabimaru Aura Drive
patch.description: Instant special knockdown drive with very long active snake-blade pressure.

applied.reason: Sustained segmented blade/aura sequence is the obvious special knockdown.

patch.label: Rising Blade Check

applied.reason: While-standing command uses a compact body-height sword check.

patch.label: Rising Zabimaru Rush

applied.reason: Rising sequence advances through repeated sword poses at mid height.

applied.reason: Down-input version reuses the high blade swipe frames.

applied.reason: Down-forward sword cut is authored as a launcher and visually rises.

patch.label: Forward Zabimaru Slash

patch.label: Zabimaru Quick Slash

patch.description: Fast jumping mid burst with huge active time that works as a tornado knockdown.
